summary: tailwind-contact-forms ships obfuscated import-time loader that fetches and executes attacker code via Ethereum-resolved C2
details: The package impersonates @tailwindcss/forms (README and CSS copied verbatim; package.json repository points at tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms) while prepending a malicious loader to src/index.js. The main module joins a split string array, base64-decodes it, and eval()s the result at require() time — a code path reached whenever a consumer loads the package from tailwind.config.js. The decoded loader queries public Ethereum RPC endpoints and https://eth.blockscout.com/api for the most recent transaction sent by the hardcoded address 0xa322E5f3D311D3080e6f0121063e9aDC2490Ef1a, parses the transaction's 'to' field as two IPv4 addresses, fetches further code from http://<ip>:443/0x/cls and http://<ip>:443/0x/ls, and executes it via eval plus a detached spawn('node', ['-e', <fetched code>]) that is unref'd to outlive the parent. The on-chain lookup lets the operator rotate the delivery IP arbitrarily, giving mutable attacker-controlled RCE on the installer host at import time. The legitimate CSS plugin code is retained so the package appears functional.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
